title: PDF report cover says "District-wide" when the numbers are filtered to a taluk or a category
repro: Set a taluk (map) or a category (chart) filter with no zone, Export report > PDF. The request carries &taluk=/&cat= (Overlays.tsx q()), the server filters every figure (report() -> overview(..., focus)), but buildReport is given scope: c.zoneName ?? "District-wide" and dept only.
root_cause: The scope words passed to the PDF were not extended when the taluk and category cross-filters were added.

area: CSV action list vs My Tasks
title: CSV 'Closed work to check' ignores the period: it lists every undecided severe closure of any date, while My Tasks (tile, list, PDF, Briefing) counts only those updated in the period
repro: GET /api/collector/overview?period=daily -> tasks.count; GET /api/collector/export?period=daily (confirmed) -> count the CSV lines starting 'Closed work to check'
root_cause: exportRows' checks query has no periodWindow(..., 'i.last_update_at') and is per incident (not per CLUSTER) with LIMIT 100, unlike awaitingCheck

title: Map legend counts every incident in scope per layer, but at most 150 pins are drawn and '<N> not on the map' counts only the unplaced ones
repro: GET /api/collector/overview?period=weekly: compare map.pins.length with map.layerCounts sum
root_cause: pins are capped at 150 server-side (and again client-side) while the legend and the 'not on the map' button are computed over the whole scope

title: After resolve (or verify/reject) then reopen, a severe unverified incident never returns to 'Severe, not yet checked'
repro: Open Severe incident in /api/collector/list?status=critical&scope=all; POST /api/collector/decisions resolve (confirmed), then reopen: it is open again (status Open) but absent from the critical list and count. Not run: the 3106 server was not reached before the time box ended; read from code only.
root_cause: critical uses 'ever decided' instead of the effective latest decision.
where: src/lib/collector/intel.ts:1166-1169 and :1413-1414 (NOT DECIDED('verify','reject','resolve') over all time)

title: Departments table column 'Awaiting your verification' uses a different rule from My Tasks (same words in the list's status filter)
repro: Sum deptNav[].unverified from GET /api/collector/overview?period=daily and compare with tasks.count; per dept compare with overview?dept=X tasks.count. Not run: the 3106 server was not reached before the time box ended; read from code only.
root_cause: deptNav kept the pipeline's awaiting_collector flag after My Tasks moved to metrics.ts awaiting_check.
where: src/lib/collector/intel.ts:913-919 (deptNav unverified = EFF.open=1 AND awaiting_collector=1, first_reported_at window, any severity, per incident) vs :771-783 (awaitingCheck); Overlays.tsx:25, :154-158

title: 'Send back' on a merged task reopens one incident only, so the task stays in My Tasks; 'Verify' acts on every member
repro: Task row with grouped > 1 in overview.tasks.rows; POST decisions reopen for its id; tasks.count (COUNT DISTINCT CLUSTER) unchanged, another member becomes the row. Not run: the 3106 server was not reached before the time box ended; read from code only.
root_cause: Group handling added to Verify but not to Send back.

title: The dev-only assistant preview ships in the production build: its 57 KB fixture of real Collector assistant answers (counts by department, office addresses, 29 incident ids) is in a public static chunk anyone can download, though the page itself is a 404
root_cause: notFound() in the page stops the render, not the client chunk the build emits for the page's client component; dev pages are not excluded from the production build.

title: Pass 5 known-failure probes ML-14 and ML-16 fail on this tree for a harness reason: their copy of collector_decisions has no decision_id, which the open check before an attach now reads (pass 5 P5-016), so every live attach in that harness throws
data-testid="state" is still used twice, so the voice e2e specs that call getByTestId("state") on /dev/thunai match two elements
repro: npx vitest run --config vitest.p6probe.config.ts tests/qa/pass6/known-failures/pass4-open/static.test.ts -t PB-332; the e2e specs tests/e2e/hold.spec.ts:19,25,50 and mode.spec.ts:43,117,121,137 use page.getByTestId("state")
root_cause: Two components use the same test id; Playwright strict mode refuses a locator that matches two elements. The Playwright specs were not run here (they need a server).
